newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ericsson may bid for Russia's Svyazinvest.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson may bid for Russia's Svyazinvest.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB may bid for a 25 percent stake in Russian telecom holding company AO Svyazinvest later this year, the head of Ericsson's Russian subsidiary said on Monday.

"We have an interest, but we need to know more," Yngve Redling, president of AO Ericsson Korporatsiya told Reuters, adding that he expected to get documents on conditions of the auction sale by the beginning of October.
Russian officials have said a new tender for the Svyazinvest stake will be held later this year.
Italy's Stet SpA won an investment tender for 25 percent plus one share of Svyazinvest late last year but the deal fell through before completion.

AT&T Corp's AT&T CIS Ltd and and a consortium led by US West affiliate Telecommunications Development Corporation Inc and including Deutsche Telekom and France Telecom said in July they could be interested in bidding for the stake.
